Title: Designing a Lizard Habitat
Content: Students decide to compare how different materials placed on the bottom of the tank affect the temperature of the lizard habitat.

Materials can be identified by their properties. `text(One)` property is how materials conduct heat. To compare the different materials, the students conduct an investigation to measure how quickly heat flows through `text(four)` different materials that could be used in the lizard habitat.
